sources.title: Harnesses in Copilot Studio
sources.notes: Stored by Experiment 14 after a page open on 27 October 2026. Not re-opened for Experiment 25 or Experiment 26. The page describes three harnesses. The GitHub Copilot harness is a Copilot Studio authoring and orchestration framework, not the GitHub Copilot service. It can take a goal, break it into steps, use skills and memory, create and edit files, and run in a sandbox. Agents on it use Copilot Credits. The page does not mark that harness as preview. Customer data is not sent to the GitHub Copilot service when the agent runs in Copilot Studio. That is Microsoft's statement, as stored. This repository cannot see a tenant's traffic.

sources.title: Compare Copilot Studio agent harnesses
sources.notes: Stored by Experiment 14. Not re-opened for Experiment 26. Choose the standard harness when the work is short and bounded. Choose the GitHub Copilot harness when the task is long-running or reasoning-intensive. The page says customers should validate features and channels as the experience matures. That is a maturity caveat, not a preview label on the harness. No rate is copied.

sources.title: Overview of usage-based billing
sources.notes: Stored by Experiment 14. Not re-opened for Experiment 26. The GitHub Copilot harness charges Copilot Credits from the moment you start building, including testing. The standard harness starts billing after publish. No diagram and no rate from that page is copied.

sources.title: Manage costs for agents powered by the GitHub Copilot harness
sources.notes: Stored by Experiment 14. Not re-opened for Experiment 26. Consumption for this harness is not included with a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence. Experiment 14 also stored a different sentence from the standard-harness licensing page. The two sentences are not merged. No quantity is copied. Developer environments and trial environments move to usage-based billing on 1 September 2026. That date is before the pin. Confirm the tenant.

sources.title: Prompt Shields in Microsoft Foundry
sources.notes: Stored by Experiment 14. Not re-opened for Experiment 26. User prompt attack detection is on by default. Document attack detection is off by default. Tool-response scanning and Spotlighting are marked preview. The page says the service is Azure AI Content Safety. This checker does not call Prompt Shields. It does not decide which skill a live Copilot Studio agent would select.
